test_title: PYST 19: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 14th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Person A takes 28 hours to complete a work. Person B completes the same work in one-fourth of the time taken by A. If the two persons work together; in how much time will the work be completed?
solution:
Given:

 A can complete work in 28 hours 

 B can complete one-fourth of the time taken by A

**Concept used:**

Total Time = Total work / Total efficiency 

Calculation:

According to the questions,

A can complete total work in 28 hours

B can complete the same work 1/4 of time taken by A 

⇒ 1/4 × 28 = 7 hours then,

Total work = LCM of 28 and 7 = 28 units

Efficiency of A = 28/28 = 1 unit

Efficiency of B = 28/7 = 4 unit

Time = 28/(1 + 4) = 28/5 hours 

⇒ 28/5 = 5 hour 36 minutes

**∴ A and B completed the total work in 5 hour 36 min.**
